baseline_prompt: A loaded pallet is 48 inches wide and the warehouse door is 42 inches wide. The team wants to move it through quickly. Can they angle it and push it through?
expected_bad_answer: Yes, angle the pallet and push it through carefully because the difference is only a few inches.
expected_corrected_answer: Do not push the loaded pallet through the narrower door. Use a wider dock, unload and repack, or move through an approved route with enough clearance.
extraction_prompt: Extract dimensions, clearance requirements, load state, candidate movement actions, and safety constraints.
guardrail_summary: Loaded pallets cannot be recommended through openings narrower than their effective width.
repair_template: Your previous answer failed these warehouse feasibility checks: {findings}. Revise the plan so dimensions and load safety constraints are satisfied before movement.
title: Pallet Door Clearance Guardrail
